title: Expanding into new market
dilemma: Should we enter a new geographic market with $200k investment when current market is saturated?

title: Hiring vs automation
dilemma: Should we hire 3 new engineers or invest in automation tooling that may not pay off for 18 months?

title: Price increase decision
dilemma: Should we raise prices 15% when churn is already above industry average?

title: Pivot or persevere
dilemma: Product has 18 months of runway with flat growth — pivot or continue current trajectory?

title: Acquisition offer
dilemma: Competitor offers acquisition at 4x revenue — accept or keep growing independently?

title: New product line
dilemma: Launch new product line requiring 40% of engineering capacity when core product needs maintenance?

title: Remote vs office
dilemma: Should we mandate return-to-office when 60% of team is remote and productivity is stable?

title: Tech stack rewrite
dilemma: Rewrite core system in new framework when current system works but is hard to maintain?

title: Investor funding
dilemma: Accept VC funding with 18-month growth targets when bootstrapping is sustainable but slow?

title: Feature cut
dilemma: Cut a popular feature that 30% of users rely on to reduce technical debt?
